official_source_snapshot_retrieved: Current LALIGA official fixture and table snapshots retrieved at 2026-10-19 10:22 America/Sao_Paulo
score_table_rule: Only LALIGA status FullTime rows with both scores are used. Win=3 points, draw=1, loss=0. W-D-L, played, GF, GA, GD and points are recomputed per club; home and away records are calculated separately.

official_table_reconciliation.reconciliation: Exact match: official table equals the final-only score-derived table; no active fixtures.

independent_ESPN_crosscheck.source: ESPN independent scoreboard API, current official final-result dates

rules.promotion_playoff: positions 3–6 (official LALIGA table zone: Promoción ascenso; LALIGA official playoff explainer specifies the third/fourth/fifth/sixth placed teams contest the third promotion place)
rules.relegation: positions 19–22 (official LALIGA table zone: Descenso; 2025/26 official end-of-season announcement confirms four relegated clubs after 42 rounds)

data_limitations: Live standings can temporarily include in-progress match states; this build intentionally uses only completed full-time results.
Some future match dates are published without a kickoff time; those remain time TBC and are not rendered as 01:00.
Current results are a small early-season sample; H2H only includes 2026/27 completed fixtures.

The 1-X-2 display is an uncalibrated descriptive independent-Poisson projection using only this season’s home and away goal averages; it does not account for lineups, injuries, opponent strength, or odds.
